devotionaura.name: Devotion Aura
devotionaura.desc: Aura: bonus armor for party members within 30 yd. Sits on the stance bar.

retributionaura.name: Retribution Aura
retributionaura.desc: Aura: Holy damage to anything that hits a party member. Stance bar.

concentrationaura.name: Concentration Aura
concentrationaura.desc: Aura: party members may ignore spell pushback when hit. Stance bar.

shadowresistanceaura.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
shadowresistanceaura.desc: Aura: Shadow resistance; raid-wide within 30 yd in Forever. Stance bar.

frostresistanceaura.name: Frost Resistance Aura
frostresistanceaura.desc: Aura: Frost resistance; raid-wide in Forever. Stance bar.

fireresistanceaura.name: Fire Resistance Aura
fireresistanceaura.desc: Aura: Fire resistance; raid-wide in Forever. Stance bar.

sealofrighteousness.name: Seal of Righteousness
sealofrighteousness.desc: Starter Seal: adds Holy damage to each melee swing; Judge it for a Holy damage hit.

holylight.name: Holy Light
holylight.desc: Big single-target heal with a cast time.

blessingofmight.name: Blessing of Might
blessingofmight.desc: Blessing: melee attack power; lasts 1 hour in Forever (was 5 min).

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.desc: Unleashes your active Seal's Judgement on an enemy. In Forever it no longer consumes the Seal.

divineprotection.name: Divine Protection
divineprotection.desc: Short self-immunity, but you cannot attack; applies Forbearance.

holystrike.name: Holy Strike
holystrike.desc: New in Forever: instant melee strike for part weapon damage plus Holy damage (10 sec cooldown).

sealofthecrusader.name: Seal of the Crusader
sealofthecrusader.desc: Seal: faster, weaker swings plus attack power; its Judgement makes the target take more Holy damage (40 sec in Forever).

hammerofjustice.name: Hammer of Justice
hammerofjustice.desc: Stuns the target (3 sec at rank 1, 6 sec at max rank).

purify.name: Purify
purify.desc: Removes a disease and a poison from a friendly target.

layonhands.name: Lay on Hands
layonhands.desc: Heals a friendly target for your maximum health and drains your mana; cooldown cut to 20 min in Forever.

blessingofprotection.name: Blessing of Protection
blessingofprotection.desc: Makes a party member immune to physical attacks for a few seconds; applies Forbearance.

righteousfury.name: Righteous Fury
righteousfury.desc: Tanking buff (30 min): more threat, especially from Holy damage. Trained at 10 in Forever (was 16).

sealoffury.name: Seal of Fury
sealoffury.desc: New in Forever: tanking Seal adding flat Holy damage per swing and a small absorb shield with a shield equipped; its Judgement taunts.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.desc: Resurrects a dead player; out of combat only.

blessingofwisdom.name: Blessing of Wisdom
blessingofwisdom.desc: Blessing: mana every 5 sec; 1 hour in Forever, stronger (Improved Blessing of Wisdom made baseline).

blessingoffreedom.name: Blessing of Freedom
blessingoffreedom.desc: Makes a friendly target immune to movement impairing effects briefly.

exorcism.name: Exorcism
exorcism.desc: Holy damage nuke, Undead and Demon targets only.

senseundead.name: Sense Undead
senseundead.desc: Tracking: shows nearby undead on the minimap.

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.desc: Ground AoE Holy damage; now baseline at 20 in Forever (was a Holy talent) and only the first 4 enemies take full damage.

blessingofkings.name: Blessing of Kings
blessingofkings.desc: Blessing: +10% to all stats for 1 hour. Baseline at 20 in Forever (was a Protection talent).

sealofjustice.name: Seal of Justice
sealofjustice.desc: Seal: swings can stun; its Judgement stops the target from fleeing.

turnundead.name: Turn Undead
turnundead.desc: Makes an undead target flee (Turn Evil talent lets it hit Demons too).

divineintervention.name: Divine Intervention
divineintervention.desc: Sacrifice yourself to make a party member immune and inactive for 3 min (wipe protection).

sealoflight.name: Seal of Light
sealoflight.desc: Seal: swings may heal you; its Judgement lets attackers heal (40 sec in Forever).

divineshield.name: Divine Shield
divineshield.desc: Full immunity bubble; in Forever it halves your damage dealt instead of slowing attacks. Applies Forbearance.

sealofwisdom.name: Seal of Wisdom
sealofwisdom.desc: Seal: swings may restore mana; its Judgement returns mana to attackers (40 sec in Forever).

summonwarhorse.name: Summon Warhorse
summonwarhorse.desc: Summons your class mount (60% speed); from the level 40 paladin mount quest.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.desc: Removes a poison, a disease and a magic effect from a friendly target.

hammerofwrath.name: Hammer of Wrath
hammerofwrath.desc: Ranged Holy execute, only on targets at 20% health or less.

blessingofsacrifice.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
blessingofsacrifice.desc: Redirects part of each hit a party member takes to you for 30 sec.

holywrath.name: Holy Wrath
holywrath.desc: AoE Holy damage around you to Undead and Demons; now also stuns them for 2 sec.

greaterblessingofmight.name: Greater Blessing of Might
greaterblessingofmight.desc: Class-wide Blessing of Might for the raid/group; 1 hour in Forever.

greaterblessingofwisdom.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
greaterblessingofwisdom.desc: Class-wide Blessing of Wisdom for the raid/group; 1 hour in Forever.

greaterblessingofkings.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
greaterblessingofkings.desc: Class-wide Blessing of Kings, trainable at 60 without the talent in Forever; 1 hour.

summoncharger.name: Summon Charger
summoncharger.desc: Epic class mount (100% speed) from the level 60 quest chain; Human and Dwarf only.

divinefavor.name: Divine Favor
divinefavor.desc: Next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock is a guaranteed crit (Holy tier 3).

oathoflight.name: Oath of Light
oathoflight.desc: New in Forever: oath on one ally for 5 min, boosting your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock on them (Holy tier 4).

holyshock.name: Holy Shock
holyshock.desc: Instant Holy damage to an enemy or heal to an ally, 10 sec cooldown in Forever (Holy tier 5, was the 31-point talent).

lightsvigil.name: Light's Vigil
lightsvigil.desc: New in Forever: mark an ally so your next Holy Shock on them has no cooldown and heals their whole party (Holy tier 7 capstone).

templarsbulwark.name: Templar's Bulwark
templarsbulwark.desc: New in Forever: absorb shield equal to your max health for 8 sec, 5 min cooldown, applies Forbearance (Protection tier 3).

swiftjudgement.name: Swift Judgement
swiftjudgement.desc: New in Forever: a second Judgement on its own 1 min cooldown, free, 10 yd (Protection tier 4).

holyshield.name: Holy Shield
holyshield.desc: Block chance up and Holy damage on each block for 10 sec, 4 charges (Protection tier 5, was tier 7).

sealofcommand.name: Seal of Command
sealofcommand.desc: Seal: swings may deal extra Holy damage; Judgement hits harder on stunned targets (Retribution tier 3).

repentance.name: Repentance
repentance.desc: Incapacitates a humanoid for up to 6 sec; damage breaks it (Retribution tier 5, was the 31-point talent).
